line_item_history.change: Featured real-output and price measures switched from fixed-weighted (1987-base) indexes to chain-type annual-weighted Fisher Ideal indexes; ends periodic rebasing/rewriting of history
Introduced chained-dollar (dollar-denominated) series and contributions-to-percent-change tables alongside index numbers; chained dollars not additive away from reference year
Government purchases of structures and equipment reclassified as government investment (capital), separating government consumption from gross investment
Improved empirical basis for depreciation and capital-stock estimates incorporated (geometric depreciation)
Introduced a new NIPA table organization and numbering system grouping measures for a given set of components and easing addition of new tables (basis of the modern x.y.z scheme)
Reference year for chain-type quantity/price indexes and chained-dollar estimates updated from 1996 to 2000
A portion of the implicit services of commercial banks reallocated to borrowers (not only depositors), changing imputed-bank-services line items
Implicit services of property & casualty insurance recognized; treatment of insured losses improved (catastrophic losses no longer treated as current losses)
National income redefined to include all net incomes; 'indirect business taxes' renamed 'taxes on production and imports'
Added special analytical revision tables (1A, 2A, 4A, 1B, 7A-7C) comparing revised vs previously published GDP, contributions, and price indexes
Industry estimates rebased on North American Industry Classification System (NAICS) replacing SIC
Introduced a new, more detailed PCE classification system (function-based categories) replacing the prior product-type structure
New treatment of disasters: value of irreparable damage to / destruction of fixed assets no longer recorded as consumption of fixed capital (CFC)
Reference year for chained-dollar and index estimates updated to 2005; incorporated 2002 benchmark input-output accounts
Reference year for output and price (chained-dollar/index) measures updated from 2012 to 2017
Industry classification updated to 2017 NAICS; equity REITs reclassified from 'funds, trusts, and other financial vehicles' to the real estate industry (mortgage REITs stay)
Regulated investment companies (RICs) output measure changed from imputed interest paid to shareholders to an imputed charge to shareholders, affecting profit/dividend lines
Fixed-asset tables added detail: new domestic/foreign light trucks, alternative electric structures, and investment by industry
Foreign-trade tables expanded with additional series and consolidation of series previously only in underlying tables
Housing-services (owner-occupied/tenant rent) PCE methodology improved using American Community Survey microdata to separate rental value from utility costs
First R&D satellite account established (Carson, Moylan & Grimm) defining R&D-as-investment framework outside the core accounts
2007 R&DSA update added industry detail (13 R&D-intensive industries), removed R&D/software double-count, added profit-margin and international adjustments
